title: Clinical Evaluation of Simcyp-Guided Simvastatin Dosing in Patients With Liver Cirrhosis

sections.abstract: This prospective open-label parallel pilot clinical study evaluated the efficacy and safety of physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK)-guided simvastatin dosing in Child-Pugh A and B cirrhotic patients with portal hypertension over a 3-month period. Twenty-two patients were enrolled following screening, and portal hemodynamic, laboratory, and safety parameters were assessed.
